\begin{abstract}

Single-pass (\texttt{1x}) linear activation steering fails in \textbf{MiniMax H3} whenever a static text/vision conditioning matrix $\mathbf{H}_{\text{prelude}} \in \mathbb{R}^{L \times D}$ is re-injected across every block and denoising iteration (\emph{the Frozen-Anchor Prompt Veto}): opposing baseline descriptors inside $\mathbf{H}_{\text{prelude}}$ re-assert themselves across all \texttt{50} joint audio-video blocks and veto rank-1 additions, whereas \texttt{2x} differential velocity guidance doubles compute and requires text rewrites. Studying all four MiniMax H3 checkpoints (\texttt{fl2va}, \texttt{ref2va}, \texttt{P-H3-Image}, and \texttt{MiniMax-H3-Image}; \texttt{5376}-D bidirectional \texttt{TokenRefiner}, \texttt{24 fps} video + \texttt{40 Hz} stereo audio single-stream DiT), we characterize \texttt{1.00x}-NFE creative steering across three coupled mechanisms: \textbf{(1) Affine Prelude Transport} combining prompt-centered rank-$r$ baseline clearing $-\mathbf{P}_{\mathbf{V}_r,\lambda}$ with soft-MaxSim target pushes $\hat{\boldsymbol{\mu}}_d$; \textbf{(2) Causal 4D Depth \& Query Routing} isolating visual/material breakout in \texttt{blocks.20..29} (\texttt{1.52x} mean / \texttt{1.75x} peak DINOv3 face retention over \texttt{blocks.0..49} on \texttt{Stage D} \texttt{90f} \texttt{ref2va} \texttt{paper\_origami}, still below base \texttt{0.399 / 0.657}), a \texttt{10}-block audio emergence lag (\texttt{blocks.31..47}), terminal \texttt{block 49} consolidation, and compiler-safe \texttt{1x Q\_aud -> K\_txt\_base} query slicing (\texttt{Gate 1} \texttt{90f} \texttt{fl2va}: \texttt{1.003x} base latency, \texttt{+0} \texttt{malloc\_graph\_breaks} across \texttt{4} backends, \texttt{YIN} $F_0 = -0.014\text{ st}$; \texttt{Mode 3} \texttt{ref2va}: \texttt{+1.06 dB}, while Showcase C retains \texttt{+0.630 st} residual \texttt{Q\_aud -> K\_vid} coupling vs. \texttt{2x} \texttt{+0.007 st}); and \textbf{(3) Reduced-Interference Compositional Algebra} addressing up to \texttt{42.4\%} cross-slider erasure and \texttt{50.9\%} shared live-action scaffolding via clamped union spectra ($\lambda_{\max} \le 1.0$), per-slider Retain-Orthogonal Subspaces (\texttt{ROS}, yielding zero first-order peer-target erasure on rank-1 pushes), barrier-aware resolved-mask grouping, and a smooth conditioning-norm knee (\texttt{95.5 -> 98.5}) that eliminated the Phase 4 \texttt{4.0 MP} \texttt{lighthouse} (\texttt{claymation + noir}) diptych (\texttt{highlight\_clip 0.07255 -> 0.00790}, \texttt{3.07s}) and reduced \texttt{box\_office} \texttt{stack3} saturation (\texttt{0.3187 -> 0.1661}). Alongside a pre-consolidation \texttt{52}-stem CPU cross-interference census and \texttt{7}-bank LOPO audit (\texttt{median cos(mu\_d, v\_1d) = 0.9935}), we consolidate the active bank to \texttt{48} verified stems (\texttt{137} \texttt{.safetensors}, \texttt{5} retired including \texttt{stained\_glass\_cathedral} at \texttt{mpc = 0.762} -> \texttt{0/2} \texttt{t=1} screening), document an honest Regime B case study (\texttt{de\_llm\_slop}), falsify unsupervised \texttt{Path 1B} token routing on CPU (\texttt{< 1.1\%} MSE), and define open \texttt{[PHASE 2 GPU]} gates for \texttt{Bus-Scoped drop\_look\_pc16} (\texttt{7.94x} CPU overlap reduction), explicit \texttt{Path 1A} facets, \texttt{Path 1C} \texttt{ColQwen} Dual-Lock release, and diverse \texttt{192f}/\texttt{243f} non-\texttt{noir} AV evaluation.

\end{abstract}

\section{Introduction: Frozen-Anchor Recurrence \& The Three-Pillar Thesis}

\subsection{Autoregressive Self-Steering vs. Prelude Input Injection in MiniMax H3}

In causal autoregressive language models, a weak rank-1 nudge $\mathbf{h}' = \mathbf{h} + s\hat{\mathbf{v}}_{\text{1D}}$ needs only to flip early discrete \emph{pivot tokens}; once sampled, those generated tokens append to the prefix and rewrite the KV cache to self-steer subsequent generation. Non-autoregressive Diffusion Transformers like MiniMax H3 invert this causal topology. H3's \textbf{Prelude} (\texttt{Qwen3-VL-32B} layers \texttt{0..49} + \texttt{condition\_proj} + 2-block bidirectional \texttt{TokenRefiner}) produces $\mathbf{H}_{\text{prelude}} \in \mathbb{R}^{L \times 5376}$ \textbf{once} before step $k = 0$, and the iterative \textbf{Core} (\texttt{50} single-stream \texttt{MiniMaxH3Model} DiT blocks) re-attends the same $\mathbf{H}_{\text{prelude}}$ at every step $k = 0,\dots,K-1$.

When $\mathbf{H}_{\text{prelude}}$ encodes a lighting, palette, material, or acoustic prior contradicting a desired edit, rank-1 mean addition fails at \texttt{1x} NFE (\texttt{0/5} \texttt{noir} stills and \texttt{0/3} \texttt{192f} videos turn monochrome; \texttt{paper\_origami} deletes foreground subjects when forced upward), whereas \texttt{2x} CFG/edit guidance doubles DiT forward passes.

\subsection{Thesis and Tightened Contributions}

This work restricts all empirical claims strictly to verified \textbf{MiniMax H3} video, audio-video, and single-frame DiT pipelines (\texttt{Table 1} checkpoints) and establishes four bounded contributions:

\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=*]
\item \textbf{Flagship Mechanistic \& Causal 4D DiT Routing (\S{}5):} Mapping \texttt{blocks.0..49} isolates \texttt{blocks.20..29} as the spatial/material breakout band (yielding \texttt{1.521x} mean / \texttt{1.754x} peak DINOv3 CLS retention vs. \texttt{blocks.0..49} on \texttt{Stage D} \texttt{90f} \texttt{ref2va} \texttt{paper\_origami}, still below unsteered base \texttt{0.399 / 0.657}), a \texttt{10}-block audio lag (\texttt{blocks.31..47}), and \texttt{block 49} sink behavior (\texttt{sol\_attn\_h3.py::SOL\_DENSE\_TAIL}). Promoting compiler-safe hooks (\texttt{steer\_attention\_hooks.py::H3SteerStepWorkspace}) delivers \texttt{1x Q\_aud -> K\_txt\_base} voice protection at \texttt{1.003x} base latency (\texttt{+0} added \texttt{malloc\_graph\_breaks}, \texttt{Gate 1} \texttt{90f} \texttt{fl2va} \texttt{YIN} $F_0 = -0.014\text{ st}$; \texttt{Showcase C} \texttt{+0.630 st} residual \texttt{Q\_aud -> K\_vid} shift vs. \texttt{2x} \texttt{+0.007 st}).
\item \textbf{Corrected Affine Prelude Transport \& Diagnostic Self-Correction (\S{}4):} We present our \texttt{Theorem 1} ridge split honestly as classical Principal Components Ridge Regression (\textbf{Lemma 1}, \texttt{5.862e-14}), whose scientific value was refuting our assumption that \texttt{M3} worked via Pole-B token transport (\texttt{97\%-99.6\%} was $-\mathbf{P}_{\mathbf{V}_r,\lambda}$). We state explicit post-RMS non-inversion ($\gamma \le 1$) and clamped union bounds in \textbf{Theorem 1} and pair \texttt{< 15 ms} Jacobian-lens introspection (\texttt{j\_lens.py::decode\_vector}) with balanced \textbf{Regime A vs. Regime B} diagnostics.
\item \textbf{Reduced-Interference Multi-Slider Algebra (\S{}3, \S{}4, \S{}6.2):} Across a pre-consolidation \texttt{52}-stem \texttt{\_\_fl2va\_\_} census (\texttt{2,652} pairs), we measure up to \texttt{42.4\%} cross-slider erasure, a \texttt{15.9\%} self-overlap trap, and \texttt{50.9\%} shared live-action scaffolding (\texttt{G = 0.1540} = \texttt{103.5x} random), show on CPU why \texttt{Bus-Scoped drop\_look\_pc16} (\texttt{7.94x} look-audio overlap cut, \texttt{100\%} Look retention) beats naive global PC removal, and verify Stage 1+2 \texttt{peer\_ros} + \texttt{soft\_cap\_stacked\_rms} on Phase 4's \texttt{4.0 MP} \texttt{lighthouse} and \texttt{box\_office} \texttt{stack3} cases.
\item \textbf{Honest \texttt{t=1} / Track 2 Push-Side Boundaries \& Dual-Lock Law (\S{}3.2, \S{}6.4, \S{}7):} Across \texttt{7} cached \texttt{.pt} banks, \texttt{35.2\%-48.6\%} of transition energy remains unexplained after \texttt{1D mu\_d + r=8} clearing. We show that high CPU \texttt{mpc} alone does not guarantee pixel emergence (\texttt{stained\_glass\_cathedral} \texttt{0.762} -> \texttt{0/2} \texttt{t=1}), falsify unsupervised \texttt{Path 1B} token routing on CPU (\texttt{< 1.1\%} LOPO MSE), and isolate the remaining prerequisites (\texttt{make\_cmds.py} \texttt{--scene-prompts} CLI, soft-hold/\texttt{mu\_a} scrubbing, Dual-Lock \texttt{[0, 0.33]} release) before \texttt{[PHASE 2 GPU]} tests of \texttt{Path 1A} facets and \texttt{Path 1C} \texttt{ColQwen} patches.
\end{enumerate}


\section{Related Work (Prior Art \& Attribution)}

To situate this system accurately inside 2020--2026 representation engineering, we explicitly distinguish inherited linear/spectral operators from our empirical joint AV findings:

\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*]
\item \textbf{Affine Subspace Erasure \& Concept Editing (\texttt{ACE}, \texttt{LEACE}, \texttt{CURE}, \texttt{Safree}, \texttt{IPErase}, \texttt{Linear-AcT}, \texttt{RASteer}):} Iterative nullspace projection (\texttt{INLP}, \texttt{RLACE}) and closed-form oblique projection (\texttt{LEACE}) were unified with activation addition by \textbf{Affine Concept Editing (\texttt{ACE})}, alongside SVD spectral/null-space diffusion erasers (\textbf{\texttt{CURE}}, \textbf{\texttt{Safree}}, \textbf{\texttt{IPErase}}), optimal-transport \textbf{\texttt{Linear-AcT}} (ICLR 2026), and retain-aware \textbf{\texttt{RASteer}} (\texttt{ROS} + \texttt{OAC}, Oct 2026). Rather than re-deriving negative safety unlearning, our Prelude operator adapts affine clearing to \emph{positive, continuous creative conflict resolution} at \texttt{1.00x} NFE using prompt-local centering $\bar{\mathbf{h}}$, $[0,1]$ polarity clamping, and RMS-locked double-dissociation controls.
\item \textbf{Video, Audio, \& Step-Adaptive Steering (\texttt{MUTE}, \texttt{FADE}, \texttt{STAS}, \texttt{TADA!}, \texttt{DATE}, \texttt{Diffusion Steering Lens}):} To our knowledge, prior DiT steering methods evaluate single-modality video or audio backbones separately --- text K/V motion unlearning (\texttt{MUTE}), frame-aware reactivation resistance (\texttt{FADE}), massive activation steering (\texttt{STAS}), dynamic step gating (\texttt{DATE}), or audio-only control (\texttt{TADA!}) --- rather than mapping depth-band specialization and \texttt{1x} query-sliced modal isolation inside a unified single-stream AV DiT.
\item \textbf{Late-Interaction Retrieval \& Static Probes (\texttt{ColBERT}, \texttt{ColQwen}, \texttt{Ward Pooling}, \texttt{Model2Vec}, \texttt{Chain Lens}):} Asymmetric row-softmax aligns unequal-length spans (\texttt{erasure.mu\_d}, \texttt{tau = 0.15}), hierarchical Ward clustering exposes Pole-B facets (\texttt{Path 1A}, CPU-analyzed), and regularized linear inversion (\texttt{j\_lens.py}) provides \texttt{< 15 ms} lexical X-ray visibility into truncated VLM + bidirectional refiner states.
\end{itemize}

\subsection{\texttt{52}-Stem Census, \texttt{48}-Stem Bank Consolidation, \& \texttt{t=1} Screening}

Auditing the pre-consolidation \texttt{52}-stem \texttt{\_\_fl2va\_\_} census (replacing v4's unfiltered \texttt{"28 / 38"} set-difference word metric) and the \texttt{6f7131dd} / \texttt{b657c6a8} stabilization pass establishes five empirical observations:

\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=*]
\item \textbf{Narrow Cosine Between \texttt{mu\_d} and \texttt{v\_1d} (\texttt{median = 0.9935}):} Across the \texttt{52}-stem census, \texttt{48 / 52} satisfy $\cos(\boldsymbol{\mu}_d, \mathbf{v}_{\text{1D}}) \ge 0.980$. Soft-MaxSim materially redirects only \texttt{4 / 52} length-asymmetric concepts (\texttt{film\_16mm\_1974\_neutral} \texttt{0.9479}, \texttt{film\_16mm\_1974} \texttt{0.9529}, \texttt{noir} \texttt{0.9702}, \texttt{de\_llm\_slop} \texttt{0.9719}) and acts elsewhere as a zero-cost refinement.
\item \textbf{Cross-Interference \& Self-Overlap (\texttt{2,652} Ordered Pairs):} Raw peer erasure $\|\mathbf{V}_r^{(j)} \hat{\boldsymbol{\mu}}_d^{(i)}\|_2^2$ reaches \texttt{0.4240} (\texttt{D}-weighted \texttt{0.3520}; \texttt{V\_r(noir)} hits \texttt{cyberpunk\_neon\_rain} at \texttt{0.3166}), while \textbf{self-overlap} $\|\mathbf{V}_r^{(i)} \hat{\boldsymbol{\mu}}_d^{(i)}\|_2^2$ averages \texttt{0.1593} (\texttt{max 0.3284}). Consequently, naive global \texttt{V\_r perp all mu\_d} loses \texttt{+34\%..+70\%} Pole-A erasure potency.
\item \textbf{\texttt{50.9\%} Shared Live-Action Scaffolding (\texttt{G = 0.1540} = \texttt{103.5x} Random):} Pairwise subspace alignment reaches \texttt{median cos(theta\_1) = 0.6691}, with \texttt{48.8\%} (\texttt{D}-weighted \texttt{49.6\%}) of \texttt{P\_k} energy sitting in bank \texttt{PC[0..15]}. Crucially, on held-out prompts, \texttt{64.2\%-69.1\%} of Look Regime A erasure energy (\texttt{noir}, \texttt{paper\_origami}, \texttt{claymation}) sits inside \texttt{PC[0..15]} (the natural live-action baseline they must clear), whereas \texttt{reverb\_cathedral} (\texttt{50.4\%-51.0\%}) and \texttt{chaos\_panic} (\texttt{59.2\%-59.8\%}) leak across buses --- requiring \textbf{bus-scoped \texttt{V\_r}}, never blind global \texttt{PC[0..15]} stripping.
\item \textbf{Regime A vs. Regime B \& Unexplained Push Residual:} Symmetric subtraction suits Regime A manifold replacements (\texttt{noir}, \texttt{claymation\_stopmotion}, \texttt{reverb\_cathedral}) but flattens both poles on Regime B directional nudges (\texttt{de\_llm\_slop}, \texttt{look\_amber\_candlelight}). On the push side across \texttt{7} \texttt{.pt} banks, \texttt{35.2\%-48.6\%} of transition energy remains unexplained after \texttt{1D mu\_d + r=8} clearing.
\item \textbf{\texttt{48}-Stem Active Consolidation \& \texttt{t=1} Visual Falsification (\texttt{6f7131dd}):} Retiring \texttt{5} stems (\texttt{earthquake\_tremor} \texttt{cos=+0.7490} vs. \texttt{chaos\_panic}, \texttt{stained\_glass\_cathedral}, \texttt{lettering}, \texttt{paper\_origami}, \texttt{wes\_anderson\_symmetry}) yields \texttt{48} active stems (\texttt{48 fl2va}, \texttt{48 ref2va}, \texttt{41 h3\_image} = \texttt{137} \texttt{.safetensors}) paired with a rebuilt \texttt{204}-term lexicon (\texttt{decone\_pcs = 0}, \texttt{47/48} matched, \texttt{top1 = 0.8298}, \texttt{top3 = 0.9574}, \texttt{mrr = 0.9007}). In 2-scene \texttt{t=1} screening (\texttt{t2va\_stairwell\_dialogue.txt} + \texttt{t2va\_restaurant\_kitchen.txt}), \texttt{stained\_glass\_cathedral} failed \textbf{\texttt{0/2} visually despite having the highest CPU \texttt{mpc = 0.762}} (\texttt{sh = 0.942}) among the \texttt{7} new packs, while \texttt{power\_outage\_flashlight} darkened scenes without drawing a flashlight beam --- leaving \texttt{4} verified visual winners (\texttt{charcoal\_sketch\_animated}, \texttt{x\_ray\_fluoroscope}, \texttt{mercury\_liquid\_chrome}, \texttt{blacklight\_uv\_rave}) and proving high CPU \texttt{mpc} is a necessary filter, not a sufficient predictor of GPU emergence.
\end{enumerate}


\section{Formal Analysis \& Multi-Slider Composition Algebra}

\subsection{Design Eliminations \& Fixed-Prompt Bottleneck (\texttt{Proposition 1})}

Rather than inflating engineering rejections into impossibility theorems, \textbf{Table 2} summarizes three structural constraints that eliminated alternative parameterizations:

\begin{tabularx}{\textwidth}{@{}XXX@{}}
\toprule
Rejected Design & Governing Constraint & Verified Failure / Elimination Reason \\
\midrule
Ungated virtual token append ($K$ rows) & Unmodified softmax partition $Z_K > 0$ & Violates $s = 0$ neutrality unless gated to $-\infty$; adds \texttt{PackedLayout} RoPE/budget churn (\texttt{MAE = 22.73-54.15} at $s=0$). \\
Mean-pooled doubly-stochastic Sinkhorn OT & Column marginal $\mathbf{1}^\top \mathbf{T} = \frac{n_A}{n_B}\mathbf{1}^\top$ & Average displacement collapses identically to $\bar{\mathbf{B}}_p - \bar{\mathbf{A}}_p = \mathbf{v}_{\text{1D}}$ (\texttt{max\_err = 8.882e-16}), requiring unpooled or asymmetric weights. \\
Unsupervised sparse dictionary atoms ($K=16$) & Sample dilution $\mathbb{E}[\|S_k\|] \le N_A / K$ & Collapses per-atom covariance rank when $N_A < 2K$ (e.g., \texttt{watercolor\_wash} $N_A = 22 \implies 1.38$ tok/atom; \texttt{noir} \texttt{0/5} B\&W). \\

\begin{quote}
\textbf{Proposition 1 (Fixed-Prompt Cross-Modal Subspace Bottleneck on \texttt{<Picture 1>} Pairs; formerly Prop 4).} \emph{Encoding $N$ paired images $(\text{Pic}_{A,n}, \text{Pic}_{B,n})$ alongside a single constant prompt $P_0$ of $M_0$ tokens concentrates leading right singular directions $\mathbf{V}_r$ onto $P_0$'s lexical variance $\operatorname{span}(\bar{\mathbf{R}}_{P_0} - \mathbf{1}\boldsymbol{\mu}_A^\top)$ whenever cross-attentive perturbations $\|\boldsymbol{\Xi}_{A,n}\|_F$ are small relative to word variance, leaving unseen opposing prompt adjectives in $\ker(\mathbf{V}_r)$.} \emph{(Operational status: \texttt{scene\_prompts} is shipped in \texttt{control\_vector\_nodes.py::make\_control\_vector\_from\_media\_pairs}, while CLI \texttt{--scene-prompts} in \texttt{bench/control\_vector/make\_cmds.py} and soft-hold/\texttt{erasure.mu\_a} scrubbing in \texttt{bench/control\_vector/helpers.py::\_apply\_erasure\_holds} remain open Phase 2 prerequisites for \texttt{Path 1C}.)}
\end{quote}
\subsection{Lemma 1 (PCRR Empirical Split) \& Theorem 1 (Clamped Compositional EQ)}

\begin{quote}
\textbf{Lemma 1 (Principal Components Ridge Regression Split Diagnostic).} \emph{Let $\mathbf{A}_c = \mathbf{U}\boldsymbol{\Sigma}\mathbf{V}^\top$ denote the centered weighted \texttt{diff\_span} matrix with top-$r$ factors $(\mathbf{U}_r, \boldsymbol{\Sigma}_r, \mathbf{V}_r)$. Because $\mathbf{U}_r^\top \mathbf{A}_c = \boldsymbol{\Sigma}_r \mathbf{V}_r^\top$ exactly by orthogonal columns of $\mathbf{U}$, the \textbf{Principal Components Ridge (\texttt{PCRR})} estimator $\mathbf{W}_{\text{PCRR}} = \arg\min_{\operatorname{row}(\mathbf{W}) \subseteq \operatorname{row}(\mathbf{V}_r)} \|\mathbf{D}_c - \mathbf{A}_c \mathbf{W}\|_F^2 + \lambda\|\mathbf{W}\|_F^2$ splits for any $\mathbf{B}_c$ into:}
$$(\mathbf{h} - \boldsymbol{\mu}_A)\mathbf{W}_{\text{PCRR}} \equiv (\mathbf{h} - \boldsymbol{\mu}_A)\mathbf{V}_r^\top \operatorname{diag}\!\left(\frac{\sigma_i}{\sigma_i^2 + \lambda}\right)\mathbf{U}_r^\top \mathbf{B}_c \;-\; (\mathbf{h} - \boldsymbol{\mu}_A)\mathbf{V}_r^\top \operatorname{diag}\!\left(\frac{\sigma_i^2}{\sigma_i^2 + \lambda}\right)\mathbf{V}_r.$$
\end{quote}
Verified to \texttt{5.862e-14} (\texttt{bench/verify\_pole\_a\_erasure.py}), Lemma 1 does \emph{not} require ColBERT; its value was falsifying \texttt{M3 = Pole-B transport} by proving \texttt{97\%-99.6\%} (\texttt{ratio 4.2x-10.3x}, \texttt{cos +0.9686..+0.9960}) was the $-\mathbf{P}_{\mathbf{V}_r,\lambda}$ term built solely from \texttt{a\_spans} (\texttt{control\_vectors.py::build\_pole\_a\_erasure}).

\begin{quote}
\textbf{Theorem 1 (Clamped Parametric EQ, Per-Slider \texttt{ROS}, \& Norm-Bounding Properties; \texttt{control\_vectors.py::\_stacked\_erasure\_block\_shift64}).} \emph{For $K$ grouped active sliders on identical resolved token rows (\texttt{\_build\_steered\_context}), define per-slider Retain-Orthogonal Subspaces \texttt{ROS} projecting $\mathbf{V}_{r,j}, \mathbf{D}_j$ orthogonal to peer pushes $\{\hat{\boldsymbol{\mu}}_d^{(k)} : k \ne j\}$ (\texttt{control\_vectors.py::orthogonalize\_erasure\_against\_holds}), stack $\mathbf{W}_j = \sqrt{\operatorname{clip}(\min(s_j,1)\mathbf{D}_j^{\text{ROS}}, 0, 1)}\mathbf{V}_{r,j}^{\text{ROS}}$, and eigendecompose with strictly clamped eigenvalues $\mathbf{d}_{\text{union}} = \operatorname{clip}(\sigma^2, 0, 1)$. Then:}
1. \textbf{Exact Zero-Point \& Polarity Symmetry:} $\Delta\mathbf{H}(0) = \mathbf{0}$; for $s_j \le 0$, erasure vanishes cleanly (\texttt{clip(s\_j, 0, 1) = 0}).
2. \textbf{Bounded Union Spectrum:} Every union projector eigenvalue satisfies $\lambda_{\max} \le 1.0$, eliminating \texttt{> 1.0} over-subtraction spikes; \texttt{r\_union = 16} (\texttt{control\_vectors.py::COMPOSED\_ERASURE\_MAX\_RANK}) spans two orthogonal rank-8 subspaces exactly ($K = 2$).
3. \textbf{Post-RMS Non-Inversion Condition:} On single-slider shifts, pre-normalization Pole-A scaling $1 - \operatorname{clip}(s,0,1)\beta_{\text{cap}}g_k \in (0, 1]$ holds post-normalization whenever the outer RMS rescale satisfies $\gamma = |s|\tau_{\text{rms}} / \operatorname{RMS}(\Delta) \le 1$.
4. \textbf{Zero First-Order Peer-Target Erasure (\texttt{ROS}):} For rank-1 peer boosts, per-slider \texttt{ROS} guarantees $\mathbf{V}_{\text{union},-k}\hat{\boldsymbol{\mu}}_d^{(k)} = \mathbf{0}$ identically without an extra runtime pass (orthogonal pushes still share row-norm budget and token bandwidth).
5. \textbf{Smooth RMS Boundedness (\texttt{control\_vectors.py::soft\_cap\_stacked\_rms}):} For any active stacked shift matrix with distinct peer entries, the soft cap leaves row RMS unchanged when $\operatorname{RMS}(\Delta\mathbf{H}) \le \text{knee}$ (\texttt{STACK\_SMOOTH\_KNEE\_NORM = 95.5}) and maps all finite inputs smoothly and monotonically below \texttt{STACK\_SMOOTH\_CEIL\_NORM = 98.5} ($\text{ceil} = 98.5 > \text{knee}$).
\end{quote}

\subsection{Single-Stream \texttt{blocks.0..49} Specialization \& Mask Boundaries}

Residual-norm profiling across all \texttt{50} single-stream DiT blocks reveals structured modal specialization rather than uniform layer processing:
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*]

\section{Systems Boundaries \& Limitations}

\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=*]
\item \textbf{Hardware Execution Boundaries:} \texttt{FrozenVideoCache} skips \texttt{double\_block} hooks and requires explicit \texttt{Mode 0} separation (\texttt{control\_vector\_nodes.py::MiniMaxH3Steer}). For \texttt{1x Q\_vid[mask]} spatial portals (\texttt{>= 30\%} queries), dense \texttt{bf16} SDPA overhead competes directly against sparse \texttt{2x} \texttt{MiniMaxH3Sol}; a timeboxed \texttt{\textasciitilde{}90s} \texttt{90f} Phase 2 probe settles whether \texttt{K\_vid} bleed and conditioning-sink online-softmax merges justify promoting \texttt{1x Q\_vid} beyond \texttt{\textasciitilde{}130-300}-row \texttt{Q\_aud} (\texttt{1x Q\_aud -> K\_txt\_base}).
\item \textbf{Modality / Tool Frontier:} \texttt{1x} Multi-Vector Prelude Steering targets styles, materials, weather, kinematics, and \texttt{40 Hz} acoustics; \texttt{2x} \texttt{MiniMaxH3EditGuider} retains novel multi-entity attribute binding, rigid-body event invention, and \texttt{< 30\%} spatial portals; \texttt{1x} \texttt{MiniMaxH3PromptExpander} owns multi-shot scripting and upstream prose cleanup.
\item \textbf{Single-Architecture Scope:} All measurements, causal depth traces, and multi-slider failure/recovery bounds in this work evaluate exclusively four MiniMax H3 checkpoints (\texttt{Qwen3-VL-32B} + \texttt{2}-block bidirectional \texttt{TokenRefiner} + \texttt{50}-block joint AV DiT). Generalization to external DiT families (\texttt{Qwen-Image-2.1}, explicitly deferred) or recurrent/masked-diffusion architectures is untested and out of scope.
\end{enumerate}
